topic.title: Minerals Planning / Safeguarding / Restoration
topic.source_contract: mineral resource identity, safeguarding area and consultation area, need and supply, extraction phase, environmental effects, restoration, aftercare, monitoring and completed land-use evidence

scope_guards: A Mineral Safeguarding Area is not a presumption that extraction will occur.
A mineral resource map is not proof of workable reserves.
A planning application is not permission to extract.
Mineral permission is not evidence of completed extraction.
Restoration conditions are not evidence of completed restoration.
Completed earthworks are not treated as successful aftercare.
A proposed after-use is not treated as operational land use.
No score or promotion is written without exact permission, extraction, restoration, aftercare and monitoring evidence.
